title: Seed Before You Graft: make every learned Scion delta reproducible

local: npx vitest run tests/scion-adapter-training-run.test.js tests/scion-adapter-tooling.test.js tests/scion-adapter-manifest.test.js tests/scion-adapter-registry.test.js tests/scion-browser-device-matrix.test.js

ciFast.note: The release will be pushed only after the focused provenance fixtures, full suite, build, bundle, evaluation, and release-history gates pass locally.

ciDeep.note: The real installed Apple MLX toolchain is audited locally because GitHub's Linux runner does not provide the pinned MLX training environment. CI exercises the dependency-free seed-wrapper contract and all byte-bound adversarial fixtures.

deploy.note: GitHub Pages deployment and cache-bypassed production verification remain pending until the exact release commit passes remote Fast verification.

liveProvider.note: No model or paid-provider request is needed to verify training provenance. A bounded ten-iteration mechanics smoke may verify the seeded local path but cannot create a quality claim.

manualHuman.note: This release changes machine-verifiable training provenance and explicitly creates no human, instructor, classroom, independent-review, or completed-judgment evidence.

strictLayeredEvaluation.note: The canonical compiler evaluation remains the release regression gate. Reproducible training infrastructure does not create held-out adapter quality or independent instructor evidence.

claims.summary: Adapter datasets bind exact source receipts, one conditional conversation schema, and admitted split bytes in a timestamp-independent identity that is independently recomputed before training.
The Scion Apple training environment is pinned by Python and package versions plus exact trainer module hashes, with separate CI-safe and live audits.

Scion seeds NumPy and MLX before trainer import, injects the declared validation split that the upstream CLI omits, bounds Metal memory with a declared physical batch, accumulation, and activation-checkpointing contract, records every ORPO parameter explicitly, refuses dirty source state, and derives adapter identity from the canonical plan.
Manifest schema v3 binds plan and completion receipts for learned adapters and carries the verified MLX source chain into separately converted browser GGUF packages.

claims.summary: The release improves future training reproducibility without claiming a fresh judgment, approved preferences, new quality weights, adapter activation, base superiority, or paid-reference parity.
